outcome: Color Doppler imaging characteristics of placental chorioangioma
cohort: 54 women with placental chorioangioma diagnosed by prenatal ultrasound and subsequently proven histologically
finding: There was no significant difference in maternal characteristics and pregnancy outcomes between women with placental chorioangiomas who delivered vaginally and those who underwent cesarean section.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was successful in 82.6% (19/23) of women with placental chorioangiomas who attempted it, including those with giant chorioangiomas (>4 cm in diameter).
